p.who: People with enough confidence in themselves to be on a dating app
p.outcome: Connect with a stranger on a personal level
p.mechanism: By identifying & surfacing intent to connect
p.quality: Go beyond the surface to discover what makes a person "juicy"
p.reject: Non-active connections & likes + matches that have low intent

p.who: The playfully intentional — they have intent without intensity
p.reject: Having to market yourself / turning dating into an audition

p.who: People bored of online dating not going anywhere
p.outcome: People who want to meet people in real life
p.mechanism: By using gamification to lower the barrier from getting "hello" to "let's meet"
p.quality: Real and genuine, low pressure, that actually happens
p.reject: Conversations that lead to nothing and don't give you any value

p.who: Introverts & people who are good at conversation but bad at selling themselves
p.outcome: Get in front of a small number of well-matched people
p.mechanism: Games / gamification / icebreakers. 3rd party (friend) help. Personality-driven profiles. Explicit intentions & guided path.
p.quality: Reduce uncertainty. We carry the "social protocol"
p.reject: Ambiguity as romance. Open-ended chats & ghosting. Pressure — "act now or else". Endless swiping.

p.who: People who are open to discovering who they're compatible with
p.quality: Help personality come through more naturally and with less intimidation

p.who: People who actually "show up" & are tired of matching with people who don't
p.outcome: Go on a date — "you meet & you already know each other"
p.mechanism: "Play" means neither of you has to be the one who tries harder. Rejection does not land on you, it's on the "game".
p.quality: You end up knowing things about someone you'd never thought to ask, so you stop wondering whether to meet & just want to
p.reject: Dating as a numbers & optimization game. That's why it feels empty & exhausting.

p.who: For people whose weeks are already full — who don't need more messages, just someone to make room for
p.outcome: You skip the pen-pal phase and just pick a place
p.mechanism: Easy to show you mean it, and easy to feel when someone means you
p.reject: Chat that never becomes a place

p.who: Open, adventurous and outgoing people who want to actually go out and make new connections
p.outcome: Meeting someone new irregardless of intent
p.quality: We make it effortless to engage with others and find a mutual agreement for a date
p.reject: Endless swiping, stale conversations and people that won't engage
